content.text: Install listeners to record errors per click, then click each one at a time.

input.command:
orca eval --expression "window.__log=[];window.addEventListener('error',e=>window.__log.push({t:'exception',m:String(e.message),at:window.__cur}));window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',e=>window.__log.push({t:'rejection',m:String(e.reason),at:window.__cur}));'ok'" --json
for p in A:e3 B:e5 C:e7 D:e9 E:e11 F:e13 G:e15 H:e17; do s=${p%%:*}; r=${p##*:}; orca eval --expression "window.__cur='$s'" --json >/dev/null; orca click --element @$r --json >/dev/null; orca wait --timeout 1500 --json >/dev/null 2>&1 || orca eval --expression "new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500))" --json >/dev/null; done
orca eval --expression "JSON.stringify(window.__log)" --json; orca console --limit 50 --json
